name: Sabul Hajeen
description: A civic guildmage in Ki'pamu who summons Kotara to avenge his brother.

description_citations.text: "The Colors of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sabul Hajeen summons the angel Kotara to kill the murderer of his brother Axdan, then has her kill the killer's accomplices and relatives.
timeline.quote: After that, he starts having her kill accomplices and relatives of the killer.

citation.text: "The Colors of Magic", section "Angel of Vengeance , by Richard Lee Byers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kotara, now a fallen angel, returns and sacrifices her life so that Sabul can kill a demon summoned by the killer's family.
timeline.quote: Thus she returns and sacrifices her life so Sabul, who has seen the error of his ways, has the time to cast a killing spell on the demon.

citation.text: "The Colors of Magic", section "Angel of Vengeance , by Richard Lee Byers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Arkol tells Pakihim of Sabul Hajeen and the Hand of Justice in Ki'pamu.
timeline.quote: Sabul finds he has to work together with his family's arch-enemy Jhossendea Ilmiera to stop the avatar

citation.text: "The Myths of Magic", section "Hand of Justice , by Richard Lee Byers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
